The new capital is expected to extend Cardiol’s cash runway into H1 2028 and fund operations through topline results from its pivotal Phase III MAVERIC trial.
Cardiol said the proceeds will also provide additional working capital and strategic flexibility beyond the MAVERIC data readout.
The company plans to use part of the funds for regulatory preparations toward a potential New Drug Application.
As of September 15, 2026, 425,000 of the original 5.71M warrants remained unexercised, representing US$573,750 of additional potential gross proceeds.
Cardiol said the warrant exercises strengthen its financial position as it advances its broader inflammatory heart-disease pipeline, including heart-failure programs.

title: Cardiol Therapeutics raises over US$7M through warrant exercises
